HikerAnthony2SeenText:
I came through the
tunnel, but I

still have plenty
of energy left.
HikerAnthony2BeatenText:
Whoa! You've got
more zip than me!
HikerAnthony2AfterText:
We HIKERS are at
our best in the mountains.
HikerAnthonyDunsparceText:
Hey, did you get a
DUNSPARCE?

I caught one too.

Take a look at it
in the light. It's got a funny face!
Route33LassText:
Pant, pant…

I finally got
through that cave.

It was much bigger
than I'd expected.

I got too tired to
explore the whole

thing, so I came
outside.
